reviews.text: Quick delivery, exactly what I wanted. I wish there was more on stock as I can not seem to find the cream elsewhere but I'll keep my eyes peeled. Lovely note in the box thank you guys and I wish you all a Merry Christmas and Happy New Year

My first item was lost by the useless courier, but the customer service team at Inature kept me informed every step of the way. They promptly sent out a replacement item using a different courier. It was definitely worth the wait. A lovely natural deodorant which smells gorgeous. I will definitely buy some more of their natural products. 100% recommended.

To be honest this item has surpassed my expectations. We didn't really know the item well before purchasing it, but looked at its organic contents, then it seemed like a good choice. We're now happy with that choice. The cream arrived well-packaged and exactly as described, but what impressed me most was the product's quality. After using it for a couple of days, I can say it's worth every cent. Communication was quick, and shipping was fast.
